item.title: Missing dropped kerb outside BAO Borough, 13 Stoney Street SE1 9AD, 10th September
item.description:
Missing dropped kerb on Stoney Street, Borough Market (SE1 9AD), directly outside BAO Borough at 13 Stoney Street, on the Borough Yards side of the street. The kerb here is full height with a step and no dropped section, so it is not passable for wheelchair users. The nearest step-free route into Borough Yards forces a long detour all the way around to a different entrance, which is unreasonable in such a busy pedestrian area. I'm a wheelchair user and this blocks my step-free access — please install a dropped kerb at this location. Photos attached. First noticed 10 September 2026; a permanent design issue, not a new defect.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 12, Stoney Street, The Borough, Greater London

item.description:

The cones do not appear to be connected to any roadworks or authorised highway works. They are being left there to keep the parking space clear. Please could the council check whether these cones are authorised and, if not, arrange for the obstruction to be removed.

item.title: Dumped furniture and hazardous waste pile outside ground floor flat, 9th September
item.description:
Directly outside the ground-floor window/front garden area beneath the first-floor balcony on 6 Calypso Crescent. A large quantity of bulky waste and furniture has been dumped in the garden area directly up against the building facade. Items include an overturned sofa/armchair, broken office chairs, metal pole fixtures, and loose debris. This pile poses a serious fire hazard as combustible material is stacked directly against residential windows and directly under an upper-story balcony. It also risks attracting vermin. Please arrange for inspection and clearance, or forward to the responsible housing provider/landlord immediately.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Calypso Crescent, Old Kent Road, Greater London
